findings.description: Critical: The delta only modifies `Choices audit workflow integration`, but the canonical `Independent read-only choices audit` requirement still says the auditor MUST NOT modify anything outside `openspec/changes/<change-id>/choices.json` and `choices.md`; the planned range output under `openspec/choices/` would still violate this unmodified requirement.
findings.resolution: Add a MODIFIED requirement for `Independent read-only choices audit` that distinguishes change-id audits from standalone range audits and explicitly permits the three D6 range effects, with a matching scenario or updated existing scenario. If standalone range ledgers are intended to satisfy `Choices ledger artifact pair`, update that requirement too so it no longer describes all ledgers as per-change-only.

findings.description: Nit: Task 5.2 requires retention failure to log a warning, but its test assertion only checks `ok is True`, paths, and the pair on disk; an implementation could silently swallow retention failures and still pass.
findings.resolution: Extend the monkeypatched-retention-failure test to assert that a warning log/message is emitted and names the retention failure, while still confirming the successful ledger write remains reported as `ok=True`.
